# Request a proposal.
For boards and developers comparing management for a Chicago-area condominium, HOA, or townhome association. Tell us about your community and we reply within one business day.

## Tell us about your association.
Share a few details and we will follow up to schedule a conversation with your board. No cost, no obligation.

- **[773.728.0652](tel:+17737280652)** Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM

- **[service@centerpointmgmt.com](mailto:service@centerpointmgmt.com)** Replies within one business day

- **5107 N Western Ave, Suite 1S** Chicago, IL 60625

## What happens next.

### We reply
Within one business day, to confirm details and set a time to talk.

### We review
We meet your board and review the declaration, budget, and current contracts.

### We propose
You receive a written scope and a flat monthly fee for your property.

### You decide
No obligation. Compare us with our free [proposal scorecard](https://www.centerpointmgmt.com/tools/compare-management-proposals).

## Before you request a proposal.

### What should we have ready?
The number of units, your current budget, the declaration and bylaws, and your current management agreement if you have one. None of it is required to start the conversation; it helps us quote accurately.

### How is the fee set?
A flat monthly fee based on the size of the association and the scope of service, starting at $20 per unit per month. It is never a percentage of your budget. See [pricing](https://www.centerpointmgmt.com/pricing).

### How long does a switch take?
Most transitions run 30 to 60 days after notice to your current manager. See [how to switch management companies](https://www.centerpointmgmt.com/blog/switch-condo-management-companies-chicago).
